measurement.requirements: Author one separate executable fixture per cited SEC document schema, with documents homogeneous to that schema. Copy the corresponding schema fact rows verbatim; do not copy typed value rows into legacy val rows or conversely. Filing date 2025-02-15; available 2025-02-16 UTC; cutoff 2025-03-01 UTC. Apply the accepted spec and function unchanged.

cited_evidence.exact_span: Legacy SEC schema: cik identifies synthetic issuer 0000000001; facts.us-gaap.Revenues.units.USD is an array of the cited legacy val fact rows. Copy only legacy rows into this schema.

Typed SEC schema: schema_version="sec-company-facts-document-v1"; cik identifies synthetic issuer 0000000001; filing_date="2025-02-15"; form="10-K"; facts is an array of the cited typed value fact rows. Copy only typed rows into this schema.

modality.mixed: Split numeric measurement and narrative fallback into separate Signals.
modality.narrative: A semantic predicate over source text; it requires a grounded LLM skill.
modality.structured: A typed point-in-time measurement whose value is fully determined by inputs and parameters; it requires an exact registered deterministic function. Only parameters actually used by the selected deterministic_function_contract affect its behavior; unknown parameter names do not implement a new guard or formula.

retrieval.comparison_requirement: Describes the intended comparison; the resolver does not parse its prose into a semantic coverage check. A deterministic function does not execute this text as a denominator, unit, plausibility or unavailable guard: its disclosed function contract owns those behaviors. Narrative skills may interpret comparison instructions against visible evidence. A text change can clarify intent without changing a deterministic result; do not claim it implements a numerical repair. Passing unchanged fixtures does not demonstrate that a claimed failure-case repair occurred.
retrieval.execution_order: Coverage must resolve before the function or LLM skill runs.
retrieval.fixtures: Non-unavailable fixtures must satisfy the same retrieval coverage as production, with literal source evidence and point-in-time dates. Missing-input fixtures may expect unavailable; technical failures are not successful unavailable measurements. For either supported Company Facts JSON body schema, explicitly supply body cik. The default fixture company candidate_fixture_N is opaque, so also supply document metadata.cik matching that body issuer. A canonical cik_########## fixture company must match body cik and any supplied metadata.cik. CIK is a positive integer or plain 1-10 digit string, never bool/float or an identity inferred from alias characters. Use a consistent synthetic issuer without recovering masked Discovery identity; preserve source values, tags, units, periods, filed dates and expected values. content is a string (serialize financial JSON). For deterministic Company Facts, each fact row must retain its canonical JSON literal in content: serialize the whole financial body with json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')), or preserve the same canonical fact-row literals inside another body format. Other source types need not be JSON. metadata is an optional object, not a universal requirement for nonfinancial sources. No consumer fills missing issuer bindings. Every fixture's expected value must agree with the skill's own documented applicability boundaries: a lookalike the skill scores neutral must not be expected unavailable, and a documented non-applicable case must not be expected decisive.
retrieval.minimum_observations: Counts the largest explicit structured series in a document: lists named prices, observations, rows or series, or lists of records with date/timestamp fields. A standalone financial fact is not such a series. Leave null unless this is a real input requirement.
retrieval.period_requirements: minimum_distinct_periods and minimum_period_span_days check period coverage, not concept completeness or comparable duration. The implementation must still check every required component and period.
retrieval.source_types: Use source types/formats supported by the supplied evidence; do not invent a provider category.

value_semantics.neutral: Available measurement without decisive directional evidence.
value_semantics.orientation: Do not equate numeric sign with Signal direction. Derive a new candidate's orientation from the observed contrast and keep its definition, implementation and fixtures consistent. Report the underlying quantity in interpretation/evidence. Do not reverse an existing stable definition or copy case labels into the skill.
value_semantics.positive: Evidence in the direction of the fixed surge target.
value_semantics.unavailable: Required point-in-time measurement inputs are insufficient.
